question: What is the meaning of cas registry number in relation to product identification?
description: The CAS Registry Number is a unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstract Service (CAS) to every chemical substance in open scientific literature. It is used to uniquely identify a product or material in the context of sustainable construction and circular economy practices. This identifier is particularly useful when it comes to collecting and linking data from different sources, as it provides a standardized way of referring to all reference standards.
